ordered_diagnoses: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ of the nail bed

finalists.label: Onychopapilloma
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence including bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia.

finalists.label: Onychomycosis
finalists.why: It has for evidence including dark brown longitudinal pigment band covering the full length of the toenail of the left second digit with corresponding nail thickening over the pigmented band and the pigment was the same width throughout the band and extended to the proximal nail fold.

finalists.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the nail bed
finalists.why: It has for evidence including intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia.

frontier_selector.why: Onychopapilloma is chosen because its for evidence specifically matches the histopathologic examination findings of bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia.
